skill.name: vision
skill.description: Use the verging.ai vision API to analyze images from URLs or uploaded files with GPT-4o Vision.
skill.summary: Analyze image URLs and uploaded files through the verging.ai GPT-4o Vision API.
skill.author: verging-ai

security_audit.summary: Most static command-execution findings are false positives caused by Markdown fences and inline code, and the key findings are placeholder or environment-variable examples. Confirmed risk remains external network use: the skill sends prompts, image URLs, and uploaded files to verging.ai, so sensitive images require user consent and clear disclosure.

remediation.suggestion: Add a clear privacy notice that prompts, image URLs, and uploaded files are sent to verging.ai for processing. Warn users not to submit sensitive images without approval.
State that vrg_sk_xxx is a placeholder and keep using VERGING_API_KEY or a secret manager for real keys. Warn users not to paste real keys into shared files or logs.
Clarify that the curl snippets are examples that users choose to run manually. Add a short reminder to review destination URLs before sending files.

content.value_statement: Image review tasks need clear scene descriptions, object lists, and extracted text. This skill shows how to call the verging.ai GPT-4o Vision API with image URLs or file uploads.
actual_capabilities: Documents how to authenticate requests with a verging.ai API key.
Shows JSON requests for analyzing images by URL.
Shows multipart upload requests for local image files.
Lists request parameters for prompt, image_url, file, model, and max_tokens.
Describes response fields including content, usage, and credits_consumed.
Provides billing details and common API error codes.
limitations: Requires a verging.ai account, API key, and minimum credit balance.
Sends image prompts and files to the verging.ai service for processing.
Provides API usage guidance only; it does not include executable helper code.
Output quality depends on the upstream model response and image clarity.

use_cases.title: Review Product Images
use_cases.description: Analyze screenshots or product photos and summarize visible issues for triage.

use_cases.title: Prototype Vision API Calls
use_cases.description: Test image URL and file upload requests before adding vision analysis to an application.

use_cases.title: Describe Visual Assets
use_cases.description: Generate image descriptions and extract visible text for catalog and asset workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Describe One Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the vision skill to analyze this image URL: [URL]. Ask for a concise scene description and list the main objects.

prompt_templates.title: Extract Text from an Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Use file upload mode for [FILE]. Ask the model to transcribe visible text and note any uncertain words.

prompt_templates.title: Check Visual Requirements
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze [IMAGE_URL] against these acceptance criteria: [CRITERIA]. Return matching items, missing items, and visible defects.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Vision API Testing
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a test plan for verging.ai vision calls using URL and file upload modes. Include prompts, expected response checks, credit checks, and error handling.

output_examples.input: Analyze a product photo for listing quality.
output: Scene summary with the main product and background conditions.
Visible defects or presentation issues that may affect the listing.
Suggested follow-up prompt for a closer inspection.

output_examples.input: Extract text from a photographed sign.
output: Transcribed visible text with uncertain words marked for review.
Short note about blur, glare, or cropped areas that affect confidence.

output_examples.input: Review a dashboard screenshot against acceptance criteria.
output: List of criteria that are visibly satisfied.
List of missing or unclear elements.
Concise summary for the development team.

best_practices: Store the API key in an environment variable or secret manager.
Confirm users have permission to send each image to external processing.
Start with smaller max_tokens values and increase only when needed.
anti_patterns: Sending private identity documents, medical images, or customer photos without approval.
Treating generated visual analysis as verified ground truth without human review.
Logging API keys, signed image URLs, or sensitive uploaded file names.

faq.question: Does this skill run a local vision model?
faq.answer: No. It documents calls to the verging.ai API, which uses GPT-4o Vision through that service.

faq.question: What credentials are required?
faq.answer: Users need a verging.ai API key and enough credits to make vision requests.

faq.question: Can it analyze local image files?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill documents multipart upload requests for local image files.

faq.question: Can it analyze image URLs?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill documents JSON requests that include an image_url value and a prompt.

faq.question: Is it appropriate for confidential images?
faq.answer: Use caution. The skill sends images or image URLs to an external service, so review privacy requirements first.

faq.question: Does the skill document data retention?
faq.answer: No evidence found in the skill files. Review the verging.ai service policy before sending sensitive content.
